coverage_assessments.rationale: E1 requires the general criminal law definition and elements of 'lawful act pursuant to statute' (법령에 의한 정당한 행위) as a justification. The only candidates mentioning this phrase (C001, C002) are from the Monopoly Regulation and Fair Trade Act and define a non-application clause for that specific economic law, not the general criminal law justification needed for a document destruction case. No candidate provides the required general definition or elements.

E2 requires the elements of the crime of document destruction and its relationship to lawful acts. None of the supplied candidates define the crime of document destruction or discuss its interaction with justifications.

E3 requires the criminal procedure for obtaining an acquittal. The supplied candidates (C011-C020) only contain cross-references to specific articles of the Criminal Procedure Act for specialized contexts (e.g., consular investigations, video investigations, appeals in special laws) and do not provide the general procedural framework for an acquittal. C029 relates to post-acquittal publication, not the procedure to obtain an acquittal.
